# A Plant — sources

Rules: skill atlas-space-topic (references/writing-rules.md) and skill industrial-3d-showcase references/fact-discipline.md. Numbers in chapter bodies are `<Num s="S#">`; part details cite `[S#]`. Design values and the simulated operating point are their own entry (the design study), with the arithmetic in the notes; they are not measurements. Reference images used for modelling are listed at the end of this file (local only, not published).

- [S1] Atlas design study for this topic: one potted chilli plant (Capsicum annuum), a model built from published descriptions and photographs, not a measured specimen or a named variety. Design values: about 42 cm tall above the soil in a pot 18 cm high and 21 cm across; main stem 1.3 cm thick at the base, forking about 18 cm above the soil and then forking again twice; leaves 7.5–9.5 cm long (older) and 4.5–6 cm (young); flowers with 5 petals, 5 stamens and 1 pistil, drawn larger than life, about 1.7 cm across; fruits 5.5–6 cm long. Close-ups are drawn larger than life: leaf block about 250 times, stem slice 8 times, root tip about 30 times, flower in section 6 times, bean seed 10 times, sprouting bean 5 times, seedlings 1.5 times, chilli cut open 2 times, angsana fruit 1.5 times, coconut 0.4 times, hooked fruit 3 times, pod 1.5 times; cells and tubes are drawn fewer and larger than real. Simulated operating point: a watered pot at about 10 am on an average Singapore day against night. Light on the leaves 500 W/m² (night 0); tiny openings open 80 % (night 10 %); water rising in the stem 40 mL/h (night 2 mL/h). / 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究：一盆辣椒（Capsicum annuum）的模型，根据已发表的描述和照片搭建，不是实测的标本，也不对应具体品种。设计值：土面以上高约 42 厘米，花盆高 18 厘米、口径 21 厘米；主茎基部粗 1.3 厘米，在土面以上约 18 厘米处分叉，之后再分叉两次；老叶长 7.5–9.5 厘米，嫩叶 4.5–6 厘米；花有 5 片花瓣、5 枚雄蕊、1 个雌蕊，画得比实物大，宽约 1.7 厘米；果长 5.5–6 厘米。放大标本都画得比实物大：叶片切块约 250 倍，茎横切 8 倍，根尖约 30 倍，剖开的花 6 倍，绿豆 10 倍，发芽的绿豆 5 倍，幼苗 1.5 倍，剖开的辣椒 2 倍，青龙木果 1.5 倍，椰子 0.4 倍，带钩的果 3 倍，豆荚 1.5 倍；细胞和管子画得比真实的少、也大。模拟运行点：新加坡平常一天上午 10 点左右、浇过水的一盆，对比夜里。叶面光照 500 W/m²（夜里 0）；叶上的小孔开放 80 %（夜里 10 %）；茎中上升的水 40 mL/h（夜里 2 mL/h）。 (Not a measurement. Plant height, leaf size and fruit sit inside the ranges of S10–S12; the flowers are drawn larger than the 1 cm of S10 and S12 so they can be seen at plant scale. The 500 W/m² is the 2023 all-sky average for about 10 am in S23. Water rising in the stem: S24 watered potted sweet peppers with 0.4–0.8 L a day; 0.4 L over about 10 daylight hours is 40 mL an hour, so 40 mL/h is an estimate of the right size, not a measured value for this plant. The share of openings open is schematic: S5 says they open in light and close at night, but gives no percentage. / 不是实测值。株高、叶的大小和果实都落在 S10–S12 的范围内；花画得比 S10、S12 给出的 1 厘米大，好在整株的尺度上看得清。500 W/m² 是 S23 中 2023 年上午 10 点左右实际天气的平均值。茎中上升的水：S24 的盆栽甜椒每天浇 0.4–0.8 升；0.4 升分摊到白天约 10 小时，就是每小时 40 毫升，所以 40 mL/h 是量级合适的估计，不是这株植物的实测值。小孔开放的比例是示意：S5 说小孔在有光时开、夜里关，但没有给出百分比。)
- [S2] OpenStax, Biology 2e (Clark, Douglas & Choi, 2018), section 30.3 Roots; used for what roots do and what root hairs are. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（Clark、Douglas、Choi，2018）第 30.3 节「根」；用于根的作用和根毛是什么。 (Read on page. Intro: roots anchor the plant ('anchoring the plant to the soil') and absorb water and minerals. 'Root Growth and Anatomy': root hairs are 'extensions of root epidermal cells' that 'increase the surface area of the root'. Text says 'minerals', not 'mineral salts'. / 已读原页。引言：根把植物固定在土里，并吸收水和矿物质。「根的生长与结构」小节：根毛是根表皮细胞的延伸，能增大根的表面积。原文用 minerals（矿物质），没有用 mineral salts（矿物盐）。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/30-3-roots
- [S3] OpenStax, Biology 2e (2018), section 30.2 Stems; used for stem support, xylem and phloem cells, and the ring of vascular bundles in eudicot stems. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（2018）第 30.2 节「茎」；用于茎的支撑作用、木质部和韧皮部细胞，以及双子叶植物茎里排成一圈的维管束。 (Read on page. Main function is support, 'holding leaves, flowers and buds'. Stems carry absorbed water and minerals to other parts. Tracheids and vessel elements 'conduct water and are dead at maturity'. Sieve-tube cells carry 'sugars and amino acids' and are 'still alive at maturity' (nucleus broken down). Dicot stem bundles 'arranged in a ring'; xylem 'toward the interior' of each bundle, phloem outside. Pith = tissue inside the vascular tissue; cortex = between vascular tissue and epidermis. This section says 'sugars', not 'sucrose' (sucrose: see S5). / 已读原页。茎的主要作用是支撑叶、花和芽；把吸收来的水和矿物质运到植物其他部分。管胞和导管分子负责运水，成熟时是死细胞。筛管细胞运输糖和氨基酸，成熟时仍是活细胞（细胞核已解体）。双子叶植物茎的维管束排成一圈；每束里木质部在内侧，韧皮部在外侧。髓在维管组织内侧，皮层在维管组织和表皮之间。本节写的是「糖」，没有写「蔗糖」（蔗糖见 S5）。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/30-2-stems
- [S4] OpenStax, Biology 2e (2018), section 30.4 Leaves; used for the layers inside a leaf, stomata and guard cells. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（2018）第 30.4 节「叶」；用于叶片内部的各层、气孔和保卫细胞。 (Read on page. Upper and lower epidermis. Palisade mesophyll has 'column-shaped, tightly packed cells' (1–3 layers); spongy mesophyll below it, with air spaces that allow gas exchange; 'Both layers of the mesophyll contain many chloroplasts' (the page does not say palisade has more). Figure caption: 'Stomata on the leaf underside allow gas exchange'. 'Two guard cells surround each stoma, regulating its opening and closing.' A stoma in the lower epidermis 'allows carbon dioxide to enter and oxygen to leave'. Water vapour leaving through stomata is not in this section (see S5). / 已读原页。叶有上表皮和下表皮。栅栏叶肉由柱状、排列紧密的细胞组成（1–3 层）；其下是海绵叶肉，细胞间的空隙供气体交换；原文说两层叶肉都含有很多叶绿体（没有说栅栏层更多）。图注：叶背面的气孔供气体交换。每个气孔由两个保卫细胞围着，控制开关。下表皮的气孔让二氧化碳进入、氧气离开。本节没有写水蒸气经气孔散失（见 S5）。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/30-4-leaves
- [S5] OpenStax, Biology 2e (2018), section 30.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants; used for transpiration, stomata in light and at night, and how sucrose moves in the phloem. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（2018）第 30.5 节「植物体内水和溶质的运输」；用于蒸腾作用、气孔在光下和夜间的变化，以及蔗糖在韧皮部里的运输。 (Read on page. 'Up to 90 percent of the water taken up by roots may be lost through transpiration' (no figure for water used in photosynthesis; conflicts with S9's 'up to 99%'). Transpiration = 'the loss of water vapor to the atmosphere through stomata'. Guard cells open and close in response to 'light intensity and quality'; at night 'stomata shut and transpiration stops'. Photosynthates are 'usually in the form of simple sugars such as sucrose', made in mesophyll cells and moved from sources (leaves) to sinks (roots, shoots, seeds); converted to starch for storage. 'Water from the roots is pulled up by this tension' (cohesion–tension). This section does not itself say sieve-tube elements are living (that is in S3). / 已读原页。原文：根吸收的水最多有 90% 可能经蒸腾散失（没有给出用于光合作用的比例；与 S9 的「最多 99%」不一致）。蒸腾作用的定义：水蒸气经气孔散失到大气中。保卫细胞随光照强度和光质开关气孔；夜间气孔关闭，蒸腾停止。光合产物通常是蔗糖这类简单的糖，在叶肉细胞中制造，从「源」（叶）运到「库」（根、新梢、种子）；储存时转化为淀粉。根部的水被这股张力向上拉（内聚力—张力学说）。本节没有直接写筛管分子是活细胞（见 S3）。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/30-5-transport-of-water-and-solutes-in-plants
- [S6] OpenStax, Biology 2e (2018), section 8.1 Overview of Photosynthesis; used for what photosynthesis needs and what it makes. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（2018）第 8.1 节「光合作用概述」；用于光合作用需要什么、产生什么。 (Read on page. Requires 'visible sunlight, carbon dioxide ... and water'; chlorophyll is the light-absorbing pigment in the thylakoid membrane. Figure: six CO2 and six water 'produce one sugar molecule and six oxygen molecules'. G3P can be converted into glucose, sucrose and other sugars. CO2/O2 exchange through stomata, usually on the leaf underside. This section does not cover starch storage or sucrose transport (see S5), and does not cover respiration day and night (see S8). / 已读原页。光合作用需要可见光、二氧化碳和水；叶绿素是类囊体膜上吸收光的色素。图注：6 个二氧化碳和 6 个水分子生成 1 个糖分子和 6 个氧分子。G3P 可转化为葡萄糖、蔗糖等。二氧化碳和氧气经气孔交换，气孔通常在叶背面。本节没有讲淀粉储存和蔗糖运输（见 S5），也没有讲昼夜呼吸（见 S8）。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/8-1-overview-of-photosynthesis
- [S7] OpenStax, Biology 2e (2018), section 32.2 Pollination and Fertilization; used for fertilisation, seed and fruit formation, seed parts and insect pollination. / OpenStax《Biology 2e》（2018）第 32.2 节「传粉与受精」；用于受精、种子和果实的形成、种子结构和昆虫传粉。 (Read on page. Pollen tube grows to the ovule; 'one sperm fertilizes the egg cell, forming a diploid zygote' (double fertilization). 'the fertilized ovule forms the seed, whereas the tissues of the ovary become the fruit'. Seed: 'seed coat, cotyledons, endosperm, and a single embryo'; in non-endospermic dicots food is stored in the cotyledons; radicle becomes the root; plumule = epicotyl, young leaves, shoot apical meristem. Self-pollination defined (pollen to stigma of same flower). Bees carry pollen on their hairs. Germination: lists 'moisture, light, cold, fire, or chemical treatments' as possible triggers; does NOT list oxygen or temperature as germination needs and does not use the words epigeal/hypogeal (dicot hypocotyl lifts cotyledons above ground). Germination needs: see S20. / 已读原页。花粉管长到胚珠；一个精子与卵细胞结合形成受精卵（双受精）。受精后的胚珠发育成种子，子房组织发育成果实。种子由种皮、子叶、胚乳和一个胚组成；无胚乳的双子叶植物把养料储存在子叶里；胚根发育成根；胚芽包括上胚轴、幼叶和茎尖分生组织。定义了自花传粉（花粉落在同一朵花的柱头上）。蜜蜂用身上的毛携带花粉。萌发：列出水分、光、低温、火或化学处理等可能的条件；没有把氧气或温度列为萌发条件，也没有用「子叶出土 / 子叶留土」这两个术语（只写双子叶植物的下胚轴把子叶顶出地面）。萌发条件见 S20。) — https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/32-2-pollination-and-fertilization
- [S8] Virginia Cooperative Extension, Gardener Handbook (2023), Chapter 1 Botany (CC BY-NC-SA); used for respiration happening day and night, plus root hairs, xylem/phloem and stomata in plain words. / 弗吉尼亚合作推广服务（Virginia Cooperative Extension）《园丁手册》（2023）第 1 章「植物学」（CC BY-NC-SA）；用于「呼吸作用昼夜都在进行」，以及根毛、木质部 / 韧皮部、气孔的通俗说法。 (Read via page HTML (WebFetch was blocked; fetched with curl). 'Unlike photosynthesis, respiration occurs at night as well as during the day.' Comparison table: photosynthesis 'Occurs in sunlight'; respiration 'Occurs in darkness and light'. 'Root hairs ... perform much of the actual work of water/nutrient absorption.' 'Xylem tubes conduct water and minerals to the leaves, while phloem tubes conduct sugars ... away from the leaves.' 'The lower epidermis contains stomata ... surrounded by guard cells.' / 通过页面 HTML 读取（WebFetch 被拦，改用 curl）。原文：与光合作用不同，呼吸作用在夜间和白天都会进行。对照表：光合作用在阳光下进行，呼吸作用在黑暗和光照下都进行。根毛承担了大部分吸收水和养分的工作。木质部把水和矿物质运到叶，韧皮部把糖等产物运离叶。下表皮有气孔，气孔由保卫细胞围着。) — https://pressbooks.lib.vt.edu/emgtraining/chapter/1/
- [S9] University of Nebraska–Lincoln, Plant and Soil Sciences eLibrary (PASSeL), lesson 'Transpiration – Water Movement through Plants', page 'Introduction'; used for the share of water lost by transpiration. / 内布拉斯加大学林肯分校植物与土壤科学电子图书馆（PASSeL）课程「蒸腾作用——水在植物体内的移动」引言页；用于蒸腾散失的水占多少。 (Read on page.
